title: Racmatta kee cayla farmoytit
intro: ucsub tibba le carra garuq lem amixxige sinni safreynit gufneh. Ken weelo qaadik tan, takkay immay ken hadaf faxem takkay immay. Oson namma agattiinah gexso milaagah yan farmo quukah, asaaluk buxah addal asaaliyya kee zambi le magaalal qarkakisa bahta. Woo cuumi gufneh yemeete mari miyyaay?
clues: Nanu waado sinni qibnaytiinot yamixxige Yallih diggale taama abeena fan rubne.
Nanu qibnayti weelol gufneeh, uxih ni qibni abba tukteenay gersi baadal ni geyto cuse.
Nanu xaagu bahne too idaltoh tan barra aamine waytuh, isi foocal cakkumsutak tootoke.
umaadoobal raddeh tan magaalal finqa radak sugte wak gitat tan buxah mara dacrisaanamih taama neh teceeh sugne.
Nanu neh xayyowte maaqot tangalem cinneh, toh dubuk ni qibnaytiino bohoy fayya hayte.
Nanu ninni nummah gino baxxaqisnem dubuk gexak naharal, nanu ku Rabbih farmoytit kinnino.
